The power Iran will possess is based on its alliance and trade with Russia. On the map, Russia and Iran are neighbors, by Georgia, and China is right there: they’re all allied now and they all got nukes. Iran is hiding its hand, selling oil to China. If America hits Iran, China and Russia are not going to allow it; they’ll feed Iran with guns. Mongolia and China are the same land mass, and North Korea is China too. The United Arab Emirates sit right under Iran, with Qatar and Kuwait; Afghanistan to the right; India got nukes; Pakistan. All the problems are going to be in the East, near East and Far East, for the West. If you didn’t believe the Bible, you better believe it now.

“Remembering their nature”: right now they’re all calm, civilized, making money, with their oil, their wealth, and their business partnerships and alliances with America, civilized through westernization. But after a while the Most High musters the battle, and they’re going to relearn their nature, become unified with the Iranians, the Muslims, and gain the upper hand.

precepts.why:
What is their nature? “And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.” He is Ishmael, and his nature is a wild man. That’s how he was able to conquer all that Africa: being a wild man, massacring, killing, depopulating parts of Africa in the trans-Saharan slave trade. That’s what he does. Ishmael is the brown version of Esau.

That’s why we feel nothing for them over there, nothing at all. What they did to us is happening to them: you reap what you sow. We have seen your works towards us throughout the Sahara, throughout Tunisia, Mauritania, Egypt. Let them continue to crush you with the American missiles and bombs. And you’re in our land on top of that; you don’t belong there and you know you don’t belong there, so our pity is minimal.

So the Arabs shall remember their nature: wild and warlike once again.

sense.text: We read that Iran and Ishmael, the Arabs, will unite, come together, and waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians, which is Israel. “This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth”: this is the whole conclusion. “And this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations”: this war is going to affect all nations, involved or uninvolved.
“For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it?” No one. “And his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?” No one.
“In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.” Isaiah saw this vision at King Ahaz’s death.

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina”: you get the upper hand with the Carmanians, but don’t rejoice too much, because the land don’t belong to you. That’s the controversy of Zion: you don’t belong there. “Because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: because you conquered the Assyrians, the Israelis.

“For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.” That’s a missile. He’s seeing the fumes of the rocket flying like a serpent around in the sky, and that’s how he can describe it; he ain’t going to say missile.

precepts.why:
“And keep silence through their power, and shall flee”: these that shall be troubled are the Carmanians and the Arabs. “And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them”: they’re going to attack them back.

“And in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.” That’s happening now. They’re trying to establish a relationship, trying to negotiate a two-state, a dual state, and it ain’t happening; it’s not working. There will be no peace, no peace talks; it’s inevitable, there’s no stopping it. No two-state solution, period. One president of Israel tried to establish the two-state solution, and they assassinated him on national television.

sense.text: “And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold”. Tyrus, when you read Ezekiel 28, is in reference to Babylon, Esau, America. “And heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets”: America is very, very wealthy, secretly.

“Behold, the Lord will cast her out”: the Lord will cast Tyre, America, out. “And he will smite her power in the sea”: this is twofold, the ancient kingdom of Tyre being smitten, and America now being smitten. America is going to lose her power over the nations. “And she shall be devoured with fire”: nuclear fire.

“Ashkelon shall see it, and fear”: Israel shall see America on fire, and fear, because the ally is gone; Daddy is gone. “Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed”: Ekron will expect America to send assistance, but America will be in flames.

On the map it’s all Israel: Ekron, Ashkelon, Gaza. All the Arabs got was a strip; they gave Ishmael the strip of Gaza. They’re all going to see America burn. That’s why the northern army’s back will be toward the Mediterranean Sea, right there.

“And the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited”: because they’ll be destroyed, burned, destroyed in this war.

precepts.why: Regarding the great city, and he will smite her power in the sea: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The sea is the nations. So he will smite her power in the sea: he will smite her power among the nations. America is going to lose her power over the nations.

sense.text: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. All we’re going to have in them trying times, when the northern army comes against us, is each other. That’s why he’s telling you, gather together. When the truth begins to spread, people are not going to want us around: ‘that’s Israel right there, look at the shirt he’s wearing.’ Your friends, your family, your mama, your daddy, your co-workers, your sister are going to turn their backs on us. All you will have in those trying times is each other; especially not desired in those times.

“Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness”: keep the commandments. “It may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” Why does he say it may be? Because some of y’all are not going to do that; some are going to turn your back on the Lord and get yourselves put to death.

“For Gaza shall be forsaken”: earlier it says Gaza shall see America destroyed. “And Ashkelon a desolation”: bombed. “They shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day”: Israel, the noon day destruction. “And Ekron shall be rooted up”: that’s Israel again, the land of the Assyrians.

“Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Tel Aviv, that’s all sea coast. “The nation of the Cherethites!” The Cherethites are the Palestinians; write that down. The Palestinians are going to get the work too; they ain’t getting spared.

“The word of the Lord is against you”: against Israel, and against Ishmael too, because both of them inhabit the land falsely. “O Canaan, the land of the Philistines”: Philistines goes into Palestine. “I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.” You will be killed out of the land, destroyed during the war, by the Babylonian, the American navy, that’s going to be there battling back and forth.

“And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”: that’s us. “And the needy shall lie down in safety”: we’re going to be saved. Why? Because we gather ourselves together, O nation not desired, that we may be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger. “And I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.”

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved”: that’s Ishmael again; you get destroyed. “For there shall come from the north a smoke”: the north is America. “And none shall be alone in his appointed times”: the smoke from the north is the destruction.

precepts.why:
This is why it’s called the smoke from the north: it’s the military, the navy. “But I will remove far off from you the northern army”: that’s the north that brings forth the smoke, the northern army coming to assist Israel during that battle.

“And will drive him into a land barren and desolate”: there’s going to be war going back and forth, war, destruction; you read about Ashkelon and Gaza. “With his face toward the east sea”: the Dead Sea; “and his hinder part toward the utmost sea”: the Mediterranean Sea. “And his stink shall come up”: because they’re going to get destroyed also. “And his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things”: against us, in America.

sense.text:
“Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman?” Teman were the wise men of Esau. “Is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?” What happened to their wisdom? They’re going to war and losing; where’s their wisdom now? Keep Teman in mind, because it plays a very important part later on, regarding the Lord’s return.

The clip shows that wisdom: ‘the United States of America is the most powerful nation on earth, period… people of the world do not look to Beijing or Moscow to lead; they call us.’ He’s saying anyone who wants light comes to America, not to Beijing, not to the Chinese: we carry wisdom, we’re the light of the earth.

“Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan”: that’s Ishmael. Dwell deep means hide: you better hide, get out of my way. “For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.” That’s the Lord talking: Ishmael, get out the way, I’m coming, I’ll take it from here. When will the Lord visit Esau? Keep that in mind.

“If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.” Esau is not like that. Esau steals everything and everyone and leaves nothing left. A robber comes in your house, takes what he can carry and runs. Esau will come steal the house and the family in the house, put on the clothes of the family he stole, put the family in the basement and lock them in, kill them, enslave the kids, and tell the kids the house was always his and they’re the parents now. Esau goes above and beyond thievery; he is the worst.

“But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself”. As we prophesy the word of God and bring this word out, Esau will no longer be able to hide himself. That’s what will make us a prime target: when we start teaching as we’re doing now and people pay more and more attention, Esau starts to close in on us and put the squeeze on us politically and financially. People start saying, them guys in them three corners is right, this guy is the devil; and that’s when problems arise for us as a people.

“His seed is spoiled”: destroyed; “and his brethren, and his neighbours”: that includes Israel too; “and he is not”: he’s gone.
“Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive”: he’s going to kill all the males. “And let thy widows trust in me”: they’re going to be in slavery.

“Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken”: that’s us. Our judgment was not to drink the cup of judgment, but we did anyway because we broke God’s laws; we drank from the cup because of our own doings. “And art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.” If we didn’t go unpunished, Esau will definitely not go unpunished: you shall drink what we drank, the drink of judgment.

“That Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.” Keep it in mind: Teman, the wise men, perish out of it, and then he mentions Bozrah.

“I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.” This goes right back to the book of Obadiah. An ambassador of the heathen, more than likely a nation of the East, will say, let us come against her and rise up to the battle, in reference to Edom.
“For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.” He’s going to make all the nations hate Edom; going back to being hated, which is happening gradually now.

“Thy terribleness hath deceived thee”. What is Esau’s terribleness? Their technology, their science, their religion, their lies, their media: that’s what they use to deceive the world, to colonize and to conquer it. It goes back to that white horse in Revelation. Their policies, the judicial, legislative and executive, the political, religious and educational, the military: that is their terribleness.

“And the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: this nation is a nation of cave dwellers, Caucasians. “That holdest the height of the hill”: that live in the mountains. “Though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle”: you shall gather yourself in space, with your satellites, your airplanes, your jets, your aerial defense systems, your drones; you’ll mount yourself as an eagle. “I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord”: when you successfully manage to get yourself in the sky and in space, I am going to destroy you.

The moon landing was 1969, and the truth started in 1969. As soon as they got out there, the truth began at the same time: that was the countdown to the end. They got to the heavens, and the Lord sent Elijah from the heavens to us to wake us up, the exact same time. That’s how he brings them down: he woke up Elijah and sent forth all the prophets, and our job is to prophesy and take her down.
“Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.”

“As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.” So this can’t be Israel or that portion of it. It refers to Bozrah back in verse 13: that’s America. No man will dwell in that portion of land that belongs to Edom; that capital is America.
“And who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?” No one. That’s God talking.

“Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman”. Here we go again: Teman goes into both America, because the wise men are over there, and Israel, because the wise men are there as well.

“Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: the least of the flock of Edom, the Israelis, shall draw them out. Who’s the them? The nations he’s preparing for battle: draw them out to war, to Armageddon, Revelation 16. “Surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.”

precepts.why:
To explain who Dedan is: “The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.” The burden of Arabia: Dedanim, the Dedan, are Arabs. “The inhabitants of the land of Tema”: Tema is Arabs as well, Ishmael, “brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.” They all work together.

So the Lord says to Dedan, flee, turn back, dwell deep, meaning you better hide, “for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.”

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” That’s Jeremiah 49:14. “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” That’s Jeremiah 49:15.

Jeremiah and Obadiah are both saying it; that’s why it says I have heard a rumour from the Lord. Each prophet heard the exact same thing the exact same way, and rumours spread from one person to the next. Jeremiah heard it about Edom and Obadiah heard it about Edom. So if Esau destroyed Obadiah’s book, Jeremiah wrote it; if they destroyed Isaiah’s book, Ezekiel said it; if they destroy Ezekiel’s book, Zephaniah said it. You can’t stop the Bible.

sense.text: To deal with the least of the flock drawing them out, the least of the flock of Edom, the Israelis, drawing the nations out to battle: “I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”: draw them out. “And will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” Parted between whom? Between the Israelis and the Palestinians.

“Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war”: draw them out, prepare war. “Wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near”: he will draw them out, all the men of war draw near. “Let them come up”: let them come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, Armageddon, the near East.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears”: prepare yourselves; don’t be civilized no more; put all that away and get your guns, get your tanks, prepare for war.

“Let the weak say, I am strong”: let the weak enlist in the army. A lot of children were killed by bombs in Palestine, and the children that survive that destruction, when they get older, are going to be soldiers: I am strong now; you killed my uncle, my sister, my brother, my grandmother; I am ready for war. The least will draw them out. What Netanyahu has been doing the last two years in Palestine and Lebanon is recruiting. He thinks he’s neutralizing Hezbollah and Hamas, but murdering all these people is creating recruits: hatred is being grown in these kids, these uncles, these fathers, and all they want is vengeance. A Palestinian who was carefree, after he sees his family die and his house blown up, wants vengeance, and they will be secretly plotting for years until finally all Arabs come together. That’s the Bible prophecy. There is a video of a man crying, holding a lifeless little girl in his arms, pleading for them to stop destroying them.

The CIA and the FBI recruit people who have no mother or father; those are the best ones. You killed their mother, you killed their father; now they become weapons for the nations. They don’t care about life, nothing but death. They’re kids now, but as time goes on they’ll be grown, and they’ll be strong.
“Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.”
“Let the heathen be wakened”: draw them out. “And come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.”

precepts.why: For the awakening: these nations are asleep, and it’s the Lord who is going to wake them up. “And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep”. As a man wakened out of his sleep: the nations are sleeping, and the Lord is going to waken them up and put their spirit on.

sense.text:
“Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine”: he is Edom. The wine goes into his policies, his governmental structure, his banking system, his religion, his military, his philosophies, his politics: all of that is lies and falsehoods. “He is a proud man”: he has taken great pride in his terribleness, as Jeremiah 49 says, and he’s proud because he’s successful at it.

“Neither keepeth at home”: he don’t mind his business. He’s in every land but his own: there’s a US Embassy damn near all over the planet, and his Navy is everywhere. America’s biggest strength is not the land, it’s the Navy; those who are ex-military, military, and agents in here know your master’s strength is the Navy. There are numerous little Americas on those boats, with nukes, places to stay, room and board, and they can stay at sea or underwater for years. That’s why Obama had such arrogance: he knows that Navy is everywhere. In military tactics every nation knows that wherever your Navy is, that’s where your strength is; there’s more sea than land, and if you have more navy in that sea you control the sea, like pirates. According to prophecy, that’s how China is going to be destroyed: the American navy will destroy them by sea. He meddles in every affair he can that benefits him.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell”: he spreads corruption wherever he goes. He poisons the water, he poisons the food, he poisons the people; he spreads hell and corruption everywhere he goes. “And is as death”: he will take you out openly or secretly, but you’re going to go. “And cannot be satisfied”: he’ll take over a land and still want another one. He’s like the grape gatherers; he takes everything.

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: America is a great melting pot; the United Kingdom is a melting pot; Rome was a melting pot; the Greeks were a melting pot. He gathers all nations to himself, and that causes social unrest and makes the kingdom weak: miry clay and iron don’t go together. That’s Esau’s habit: he must have all nations together. That’s his Babylonian habit, his Babylonian side; brother Nimrod wanted all nations together.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him”: all these nations that he heaps up to himself shall take up a parable against him, “and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Has not Esau, the so-called white man, increased upon what is not his? Has he not gained wealth and power on this earth by taking things that do not belong to him? Africa he took, Australia he took, America he took, Israel he took. He even took inventions: I made the light bulb, I made the street light; no you didn’t. He made damn near nothing; he steals everything, steals the patents, takes credit and gains wealth from it.

When they divided Africa, France, America, the British, Spain, each took a part and robbed Africa of all its resources. When you see France with a nice country, it’s not because he was wise; it’s robbing. The crown of their witch that just died wasn’t even hers; all that gold was stolen. That’s their job; that’s their spirit.

precepts.why: Regarding wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” Falsehood and lies are what wine and strong drink represent. So when Edom transgresses by wine, he transgresses by his lies and falsehoods.

Another example of his falsehoods and lies, regarding wine: “And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions”. Secret plots. Popular persuasions are their religion, their politics and their media: that is their wine.

Commotions go into destabilizing countries. They send in a jackal, a small paramilitary, and go in and destabilize countries, people and lands. Back then they set up vassal kings; now they have puppet presidents, puppet leaders. They cause coups in different countries and set up leaders that bend to America’s or Israel’s will, or cause riots: Haiti today is a prime example, and different parts of Africa. The agency they use to do that is the CIA: they built it to go into other countries and disable them. And who runs the CIA, who’s behind it? The Israelis. That’s why Jeremiah 49 says he’s going to uncover the secret places of Edom: these guys move real slick and cunning, in the dark, behind closed doors.

The clip lays it out: Al-Qaeda in Afghanistan, and the Taliban now has all their arms and weapons. President Sukarno in Indonesia was communicating with John F. Kennedy about a Muslim and American union, and the CIA staged the coup that overthrew him, resulting in the deaths of five hundred thousand to a million Indonesian civilians. Iraq was based on false intelligence. They created ISIS and the so-called moderate Free Syrian Army. They’re behind every evil you can think of.

Even Trump said it: the Middle East would be better off with Gaddafi and Saddam Hussein in power; Iraq is now the Harvard of terrorism, and Libya is a catastrophe. Patrice Lumumba, Gaddafi, Saddam Hussein: they’re always behind it all. Trump breaks code; he says openly the things we bring out of the scripture, things that should remain unsaid.

This is nothing new under the sun. “But with their friends and such as relied upon them they kept amity”: if you were at peace with the Romans, they were at peace with you. “And that they had conquered kingdoms both far and nigh, insomuch as all that heard of their name were afraid of them”: that’s what Obama said, people are afraid of us; if they mess around with us it’ll be their ruin.

“Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace: finally, that they were greatly exalted”. Whoever they want to rule, rules, and whoever they want out of the way gets out of the way. The CIA, same thing: foreign destabilization, coups. It’s the same philosophy from Rome to America, from the Greeks to America.

sense.text: “And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.” The flying roll is more than likely a chariot. It’s not a roll of paper.

“Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it”. There is writing on it: he that steals shall be cut off on this side. “And every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it”: him that swears, that transgresses by wine, that makes false oaths and lies, across the other side.

“I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief”. It doesn’t say the thieves; it says the thief, because there is one nation in particular that steals the most and lies the most above all the others. Ishmael stole, others stole, but this one is the thief, the head.

“And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”: how does he do that? Christ is white, God is white, the prophets are white; I’m a Jew, I’m the chosen people of God; you guys are monkeys and Africans; Native Americans are savages. Manifest Destiny, the Berlin Conference, the Scramble for Africa, white Jesus, whitewashing all the images, stealing the land of Israel and the land of America: swearing falsely by his name as a Christian, or as a Jew, as an Israeli.

“And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.” Can a flying roll of paper do that? No. An FBI document from San Diego, California, July 8, 1947, says ‘a very serious situation may develop at any time with regard to the flying saucer.’ So that flying roll is a flying saucer. sense.text:
“Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Destruction to the thief. “And to him that ladeth himself with thick clay”: the thick clay of nations he heaped unto himself.

East Indians, Arabs that was born American, rising up in the same way and saying to the government, you are wrong for what you doing. You saw all the protests, all these Arabs and all these people protesting about what is going on in Palestine, in Gaza.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee”: awake. Remember earlier, draw them out; waken them up, draw them out. “And thou shalt be for booties unto them”: you shall be spoiled unto them.

precepts.why:
“Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong”: that’s us, make the watch strong. “Set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.”

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: we just read this before. “Abundant in treasures”: how? Because he stole it. Abundant in treasure from stealing it. “Thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness”: you take things that do not belong to you. He takes things that’s not his.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers”, and what will they do? They will awake. That is your sleeper cells, that is your terrorists; those that are weak will become strong and bomb this place. “And they shall lift up a shout against thee”: they shall shout against you, begin to attack from the inside. Terrorist activity. That is the awaking that vexes the thief in Habakkuk.

“Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out.” The Israelis represent Teman also. They’re the wise also; they’re the bankers, they deal with the money, the funds, so that’s wise men too. “Surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.”

“The earth is moved at the noise of their fall”: the noise of Edom. “At the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea”, which borders the Middle East.

“Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah”: then America will come, the Navy will come and arrive, to try to protect Bozrah. “And at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman”: why? Because of the terrorist attacks, and when she starts to get attacked herself from the EU and so on and so forth. They going to be like a punk, like a woman.

sense.text: “Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans”: move out the midst of Babylon means out of her ways.

“I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country”: the north country goes into Russia. “And they shall set themselves in array against her”: that goes into Russia as well as Iran, because they’re all neighboring. “Their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man”: this is going into the EU; pretty much the EU and Russia. “None shall return in vain”: it’s going into missiles.
“O ye destroyers of mine heritage”: Edom are the destroyers of God’s people. “Because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls”: they’re wealthy.

“Your mother shall be sore confounded”: Britain, that’s the EU; it be confounded also. “Behold, the hindermost of the nations”: hindermost means the nations who are beneath America, the bottom. They shall be “a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert”: they going to get destroyed also.

“Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited”: this is Babylon, America. “But it shall be wholly desolate”: remember earlier in Isaiah 13, to destroy the whole land. “Every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished”: Gaza will be astonished, Edom be astonished, Ashkelon be astonished. They shall all be astonished.

“Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows”: shoot all your bombs. Press the button multiple times; just keep hitting the button till the clip is all shot out. “For she hath sinned against the Lord.”

“Shout against her round about”: earlier it said they will awake within her and shout against her. She’s going to be attacked from the inside, and she’s going to be attacked from the outside. “She hath given her hand”: she’s going to be as a woman. “Her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her”: do unto her what she done to us.

“Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest”: there ain’t going to be no crops; it’s going to be destroyed, it’s going to be burned. The sower is a worker, the people that live and work here. Those who come here for work, they’re going to leave.

“For fear of the oppressing sword”: for fear of nuclear war. The oppressing sword is the nukes, the fear of war. “They shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.” When word of war takes place, people are going to start to desert America. They going to fly out, drive out, swim out, whatever, when they realize America’s under attack: terrorism first, then the threat. It’s going to be known on the broadcast system that war is taking place, unavoidable, conflict is imminent, and they going to say it in a real friendly way: we’re in trouble; if you can leave, leave.

Why did all nations come to America? For the American dream. When it becomes evident that the American dream don’t exist, that the American dream is a nightmare, that America is no more the land of opportunity, those nations that came here to become rich, for a better life and opportunity, are going to leave. In the islands, in India, so many want to come to America, and it’s all going to end. If you’re from India you’re going back to India; if you’re from China, back to China; if you’re from Japan, Japan; if you’re from Africa, Africa. If you’re from here, you just going to be here.

“Israel is a scattered sheep”: Israel among us in these places; we are a scattered sheep. “The lions have driven him away”: the lions have scattered us into the four corners. “First the king of Assyria hath devoured him”: that’s the northern kingdom. “And last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.”

This is a deeper verse. Was Babylon the last to devour us? No: the Greeks broke us and the Romans broke us. So why is it saying last? Because this Babylon is not ancient Babylon. This is the new Babylon, just as there is a new Assyria over there in Israel now.

What nation represents Assyria today? Esau, over in Israel. Who are they before they became Israeli? The Khazar goes back to the title Kesar: Caesars, Kaisers. They were Romans first. The Romans chased us out of our land, then they converted and moved back into our land: that’s the Assyrians. Rome conquered us out of our land and took it over and became inhabitants of it; then over time they migrated into the Caucasus mountains and made their way into Russia and became Kesar, Caesars, over there; then they converted to ours. They migrated to Spain, conquered our sister the Moors and became conquistadors, then came over here and conquered and displaced the northern kingdom, which is what the Assyrians did and what the Babylonians did. Then they came lastly as Babylon and took us over and brought us over here as slaves to America. That’s why it says last.

In context, Assyria conquered Ephraim first and Babylon conquered Judah. But Esau portrayed himself as both kingdoms, so this is referring to Edom in both directions: as the Assyrians and as the Babylonians.

“Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.” Edom is both: Israel, which is his land now, and America, which is our land, and it’s his land now. He’s going to punish him in both lands.

“And I will bring Israel again to his habitation”: he’s going to bring us into our land again. “And he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead”: you going to be back in that land; both kingdoms will be back in their land.

“In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none”: because we’ll all be righteous. “And the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.” This is future prophecy; it never happened in ancient Babylon.

precepts.why:
The last part of the beast is iron mixed with clay, and with the wars going on everybody is going to have to choose a side. “And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay”: the toes and the feet are the ending part of the kingdom, the European Union and America.
